scripts.test: pnpm run build && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json && c8 node --test "test/**/*.test.ts"
scripts.start: pnpm run build && fastify start -l info dist/app.js
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @surflog/shared build && pnpm run clean && tsc
scripts.dev: pnpm run build && concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "Shared,TypeScript,App" -c "green.bold,yellow.bold,cyan.bold" "pnpm --filter @surflog/shared run dev:watch" "pnpm run watch" "pnpm run dev:start"
scripts.db:migration: printf 'Migration name: '; read -r value && supabase db diff -f "$value"
scripts.openapi:generate: node src/scripts/openapi.ts && pnpm dlx openapi-typescript ./generated/openapi.json -o ../../packages/shared/src/generated/openapi.ts && pnpm --filter @surflog/shared build
